question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched control over the Chinese Communist Party, state presidency, and Central Military Commission underpins the 96% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Recent military leadership purges have further centralized authority in his hands without visible factional challenges, while the absence of a designated successor and continuity in public appearances through mid-2026 signal preparation for a fourth term at the 2027 Party Congress rather than an abrupt exit. Historical patterns tie major leadership changes to scheduled congresses, and elite cohesion remains intact amid surveillance mechanisms and policy continuity. Realistic shifts could still arise from an unforeseen health event, severe economic pressures prompting internal realignment, or an external crisis eroding elite support before the resolution window closes.
